The symptoms are worse in the morning and improve with activity. Physical examination shows swelling and warmth over the MCP and wrist joints in both hands. An x-ray of the hands is shown. Synovial biopsy from an affected joint would most likely show which of the following?

Options:
opa. Noninflammatory superficial fibrin deposits
opb. Monosodium urate crystals
opc. Calcium pyrophosphate crystals
opd. Noncaseating granulomas
ope. Proliferation of granulation tissue
